messages.text:
"Create a fully playable 2D JRPG prototype inspired by the golden age of 16-bit RPGs, especially Chrono Trigger.

GAME CONCEPT
Create an original fantasy RPG called \"Echoes of Eternity\". The player controls a young adventurer who discovers an ancient portal capable of transporting them between different historical eras.

VISUAL STYLE

- Beautiful 16-bit pixel art.
- Detailed environments and animated characters.
- Top-down RPG perspective.
- Colorful fantasy landscapes.
- Retro JRPG atmosphere.
- Smooth animations and visual effects.
- Responsive interface optimized for mobile phones.

PLAYABLE CHARACTER
Create a main character with:

- 8-direction movement.
- Walking and running animations.
- Character interaction with NPCs.
- Health points (HP) and magic points (MP).
- Experience and leveling system.
- Inventory and equipment.

GAME WORLD
Build three explorable areas:

1. Medieval Village: houses, shops, NPCs and a mysterious castle.
2. Ancient Forest: enemies, treasures, hidden paths and a mini-boss.
3. Future Ruins: futuristic machines, abandoned buildings and a time portal.

GAMEPLAY
Implement functional mechanics:

- Movement using keyboard and virtual mobile joystick.
- Interaction button.
- Dialogue system with NPCs.
- Treasure chests with collectible items.
- Enemy encounters.
- Turn-based combat system.
- Basic attack, magic, items and escape options.
- Enemy AI with functional attacks.
- Experience and rewards after battles.
- Save and load game functionality.

COMBAT SYSTEM
Create a classic JRPG turn-based battle interface:

- Player and enemy sprites.
- HP and MP bars.
- Attack, Magic, Items and Defend commands.
- Damage calculations.
- Enemy turns.
- Victory and defeat screens.

STORY
The player discovers that an ancient civilization created portals through time. A mysterious enemy is changing historical events, threatening to destroy the timeline.

Create an introductory cinematic and a short quest that leads the player through all three areas.

PROTOTYPE REQUIREMENTS

- The game must be playable from beginning to end.
- All buttons must work.
- No placeholder interactions.
- All maps must be connected.
- Combat must function correctly.
- Include at least one boss fight.
- Include a clear objective and quest progression.
- Add sound effects and background music.
- Optimize performance for mobile devices.

IMPORTANT
Prioritize functional gameplay over visual complexity. Build a complete playable vertical slice rather than a collection of disconnected screens. Do not leave unfinished mechanics or non-functional buttons.

The prototype should allow the player to explore, fight, collect items, level up, defeat a boss and complete the first chapter.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
